##: Scoop manifest for the Lumen toolchain. The Lumen repository is its own
bucket: `scoop bucket add lumen https://github.com/lumen-fx/lumen`
clones it, and Scoop reads the manifests in its bucket/ directory.
Every release rewrites this file on main with
tools/release/update-package-manifests.sh, from the scoop job in
.github/workflows/publish-packages.yml, so main always carries the
newest stable release.
The source is the portable Windows zip, not the MSI: scoop owns where an
app lives and how it is removed, and the MSI would install a second copy
beside it with its own entry in Installed apps. The zip also carries no
receipt under share/lumen, so the built-in update check stays off and
`scoop update` is the only thing that moves the version.
extract_dir flattens the archive's bin/ directory into the app directory,
which keeps lumenc.exe, lumen.dll, and lumen-launcher.exe together.
lumenc loads the runtime library from beside its own executable and
`lumenc package` looks for the launcher stub there too, so splitting them
up breaks both. lumen-server.exe, the production server for
server-rendered sites, and lumen-lsp.exe, the language server the editor
integrations start, are shimmed beside lumenc.exe. lumen-crash.exe, the
crash helper `lumenc package` copies into every package, sits beside
lumenc.exe unshimmed: nobody runs it by hand.
Both Windows architectures are listed. Scoop picks the one matching the
machine, so an Arm64 machine gets the native build instead of the x64
one it would otherwise run under emulation.
description: Toolchain for Lumen, a markup-first UI framework for native desktop apps
